余料建造在初始空岛的伊萨神庙取得，取得后按住相应按键就能把素材贴到武器或盾上。素材来源遍布全游戏：怪物角、龙角、宝石、骨头，几乎所有能捡的材料都能贴。贴之前先看攻击值，别把高攻素材贴到快坏的低攻武器上浪费。

Fuse is obtained at the In-isa Shrine on the Great Sky Island, and after that, holding the corresponding button lets you fuse materials onto weapons or shields. Material sources are found all over the game: monster horns, dragon horns, gems, and bones, and almost every material you can pick up can be fused. Check the attack value before fusing, and do not waste a high-attack material on a nearly broken low-attack weapon.

融合不只加攻击，还给武器加额外耐久，通常是 +25。但有几类武器例外：近卫武器和瘴气武器只加 10，格鲁德武器只加 5，骨武器只加 3，锈武器和木质武器加 10。贴素材前先看武器种类，别指望格鲁德武器靠余料补很多耐久，它的优势在翻倍攻击，不在耐久。

Fusing adds more than attack: it also gives a weapon bonus durability, usually +25. A few weapon types are exceptions: Royal Guard's and Gloom weapons add only 10, Gerudo weapons only 5, bone weapons only 3, and rusty and wooden weapons 10. Check the weapon type before fusing, and do not expect a Gerudo weapon to gain much durability from Fuse; its advantage is doubled attack, not durability.
贴错了怎么办？在背包里直接拆解会销毁素材，素材就没了。正确做法是去一始村的拆解屋找佩里森，花 20 卢比就能无损拆回，武器和素材都保留。高攻素材一律走拆解屋拆，别在背包里手滑销毁。

What if you fuse the wrong thing? Dismantling directly from your inventory destroys the material, and it is gone for good. The right way is to go to Pelison at the Break-a-Part shop in Tarrey Town, where 20 Rupees separates them with nothing lost, keeping both weapon and material. Always take high-attack materials to the Break-a-Part shop, and do not accidentally destroy them from your inventory.
余料的上限来自武器特效配合：格鲁德武器让素材攻击翻倍，七宝匕首本身 28，贴刃角 55 后翻倍得 138；卓拉武器沾水翻倍，光鳞之枪 22 贴刃角 55 得 77，沾水后 154，配合希多的水盾使用，见本站五位贤者能力全解。这两个配合是余料系统的毕业玩法，武器和素材要成套准备。

The ceiling of Fuse comes from weapon-effect combos: Gerudo weapons double material attack, so the Scimitar of the Seven at 28 plus a doubled 55 blade horn reaches 138; Zora weapons double when wet, so the Lightscale Trident at 22 plus a 55 blade horn totals 77 and reaches 154 when wet, used together with Sidon's water shield, as covered in this site's All Five Sages' Abilities Explained. These two combos are the endgame of the Fuse system, and weapons and materials should be prepared as sets.
